author: GamingBolt
description:
2026 is a year with no shortage of variety; the quality of releases has surprisingly matched the breadth, reminding us that your backlog isn't getting any smaller anytime soon. 

Even if there was sheer trepidation at the number of games to look forward to in such a short space, the past weeks have proven that there too much of a good thing may not be all that bad. And as much as there's fear about triple-A titles dumbing things down to attract the widest audience, a boatload of other releases prove just how engaging the medium can be, regardless of budget.
title: The Last Several Weeks Have Been One of the Best Stretches for Video Games in Years

author: GamingBolt
description:
2026 is the year of many comebacks and revivals, but even if it isn't a sequel to the beloved Episode 1: Racer, Star Wars: Galactic Racer is a true-blue successor in every way. 

Developed by Fuse Games and launching October 6th for Xbox Series X/S, PS5, and PC, it aims to capture that high-speed, pod-racing fantasy with sleeker visuals, higher stakes, and, of course, more vehicle variety.
title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer - 15 Things You NEED TO KNOW Before You Buy

author: GamingBolt
description: Silent Hill: Townfall might be a much more contained experience than recent series entries, but thanks to a strong story, unsettling atmosphere, and tense gameplay, it nonetheless shines just as bright.
title: Silent Hill Townfall Review - The Final Verdict
